verdict.rationale: Jan ships a local inference API server powered by llama.cpp, so KV-cache memory management is a fair axis for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions paged KV-cache management, concurrent request capacity, or fragmentation handling. The llama.cpp backend mention is a host-engine detail and documents nothing about this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
